KennenShurikenStorm.name: Slicing Maelstrom
KennenShurikenStorm.tooltip:
Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing @PerTickDamageCalculated@ magic damage to all nearby enemies every @KennenRTickRate@ seconds, and gaining @KennenRDefenses@ Armor and @KennenRDefenses@ Magic Resist for @KennenRDuration@ seconds. Successive hits deal @DamageAmp*100@% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.
Enemies can only receive 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm from this ability.

KennenLightningRush.name: Lightning Rush
KennenLightningRush.tooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining @MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for @DurationAsBall@ seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains @EnergyRefund@ Energy.

After this ability ends, Kennen gains @TotalAS*100@% Attack Speed for @DurationAfterBall@ seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by @CritDurationBonus@ second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.
Ghosted units can pass through other units.
Deals @DamageToMinions*100@% damage to minions and jungle monsters.
Duration cannot be extended beyond its initial value.

KennenLRCancel.name: Lightning Rush Cancel
KennenLRCancel.tooltip: You can activate Lightning Rush again right now to cancel the current spell.

KennenBringTheLight.name: Electrical Surge
KennenBringTheLight.tooltip:
Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional @TotalDamagePassive@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing @TotalDamageActive@ magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm.

The passive also applies Mark of the Storm and can critically strike for @TotalDamagePassiveCrit@ instead.
Attacking structures will stack the passive, but not expend it. The active automatically hits enemies inside of Slicing Maelstrom.
